reason: This PR looks central and risky enough for a deep review. It changes core expression copying/evaluation behavior and multiple planner rules/plan-building paths (`find_best_task`, join logic, predicate simplification, functional dependency handling), and the test/result churn spans MPP, TPCH, explain, null-rejection, and integration plan outputs. A mutation bug in expression trees can silently alter optimizer semantics and plan correctness across many queries, which is exactly the kind of high-blast-radius area worth a 20-40 minute blocker/high-severity review.
